PROBLEM_HEADLINE: Most finance apps are built to collect your data
PROBLEM_BODY:
Free apps are rarely free — they monetise your financial data through ads, offers, or resale. Many also ask for your bank login so an aggregator can pull in your transactions.

FincWin is funded by Pro subscriptions, not your data. Your data lives in your own account, not on your phone alone. FincWin keeps every household’s records isolated from every other household, and lets you export or permanently delete your data at any time.

FAQ_ITEMS:
Where is my financial data stored?

Your data lives in your own account, not on your phone alone. FincWin keeps every household’s records isolated from every other household, and lets you export or permanently delete your data at any time. Backup to your own Google Drive is optional.

Do you sell or use my data?

No. There are no ads and no data resale. The app is funded by Pro subscriptions, not your data.

Can I lock the app?

Yes — you can protect the app behind an optional PIN.
